name: Royal Kaptaan Pebble Grain Leather Chappal
subtitle: Handcrafted textured calfskin with ergonomic double sole and brass buckle accent
description: Exquisitely tailored from premium pebble-grain leather, this Kaptaan chappal showcases intricate contrast hand-stitching along its iconic folded silhouette. The cushioned footbed and robust tire-rubber sole provide exceptional all-day support while honoring centuries of Pashtun heritage. Perfectly crafted to elevate traditional Shalwar Kameez or sophisticated formal ensembles.
features: Handcrafted by master footwear artisans in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Premium pebble-grain leather upper with hand-waxed double contrast stitching
Durable recycled truck-tyre rubber sole engineered for maximum traction
Adjustable heel strap with solid brass buckle for a customized fit
materials: 100% Pebble-Grain Cowhide Leather Upper, Recycled Tyre Rubber Sole, Padded Comfort Insole, Solid Brass Buckle
